evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: a solid understanding of data governance, data quality, and testing practices (e.g. dbt tests, CI/CD pipelines)
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (data governance, data quality, testing, accuracy, consistency, regulatory reporting) dominate throughout with no velocity/speed language present.
evidence.domain_risk: producing mandatory reporting for German regulatory authorities
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role explicitly owns mandatory financial reporting to German regulatory authorities alongside CFO/FP&A decision-making, placing it firmly in high domain risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: As our Analytics Engineer for Finance, you will own the data modelling and reporting that empowers our CFO, Controlling, and FP&A teams
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named Senior Manager Data Strategy, dedicated Finance-domain analytics role, and existing dbt/BigQuery/Looker stack indicate an established, specialised data organization.
evidence.jd_authorship: by owning critical recurring finance operations, including running the monthly financial sales closing process (Excel), maintaining finance mapping tables (e.g. Geographical Business Unit mappings, article hierarchy)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities describe precise, specific operational tasks (monthly sales closing, specific mapping tables, named regulatory reporting) that a reader could picture doing on a Tuesday morning.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: you will own the data modelling and reporting that empowers our CFO, Controlling, and FP&A teams to make truly data-driven decisions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The entire role is framed around serving Finance stakeholders (CFO, Controlling, FP&A, Accounting) with financial reporting, decisively finance-oriented.
evidence.autonomy_level: by owning Looker reporting for Finance and developing and optimizing LookML models
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines strategic ownership of financial data models and KPI governance with hands-on execution of recurring manual finance operations (Excel closing process).
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools, AI-assisted coding, or AI-consuming infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: translating finance business requirements into robust, well-tested data models and automated reporting solutions
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and data governance are framed as something the candidate owns and ensures ('ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and governance'), not just a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: producing mandatory reporting for German regulatory authorities
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High: regulatory reporting obligations and repeated accuracy/consistency/governance language for financial data dominate the role framing from the first responsibility onward.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: identifying and prioritizing automation opportunities to reduce manual finance operations over time
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role mixes building new scalable data models (greenfield) with maintaining and gradually automating existing manual Excel-based processes (fix_scale).
evidence.language_gate: very good written and spoken English skills; German is a plus
evidence.urgency: A full-time position at our Headquarters in Hamburg starting immediately.
evidence.loss_aversion: producing mandatory reporting for German regulatory authorities — regulatory exposure and financial data accuracy are framed as core to the role, not secondary operational concerns.
